item.title: Fighting Temptation With the Word of God
item.description: In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins explains how Christians can fight temptation biblically using Scripture. Drawing from Psalm 119:11 and Jesus' example in Matthew 4, this episode teaches how believers resist sin by knowing, believing, speaking, and obeying God's Word.

item.title: Psalm 15 — Who May Dwell with God?
item.description: In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, Dave Jenkins walks through Psalm 15 and explains who may dwell in the presence of the Lord. This episode highlights the holiness of God, the character He requires, and how Christ fulfills Psalm 15 by granting believers access to God through His righteousness.

item.title: How the Local Church Strengthens the Christian Family
item.description: In this episode of Equipping You in Grace, Dave Jenkins explains how God designed the family and the local church to flourish together through faithful preaching, discipleship, and biblical fellowship.

item.title: Why Godly Men Need Brotherhood
item.description: God never designed men to walk alone. In this episode of Warriors of Grace, Dave Jenkins explains why godly brotherhood strengthens faith, guards purity, and fuels perseverance. Drawing from Ecclesiastes 4:9–12 and Proverbs 27:17, this episode calls Christian men to reject isolation and pursue biblical community.

item.title: Psalm 16 — God Our Refuge, Joy, and Eternal Inheritance
item.description: In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, Dave Jenkins walks through Psalm 16 and shows how true security, lasting joy, and a beautiful inheritance are found in God alone. Psalm 16 moves from refuge in the Lord to delight in God’s people, from rejecting idols to resting in God’s counsel, and ultimately to resurrection hope fulfilled in Jesus Christ. item.title: Guard Your Heart: Biblical Wisdom for Faithful Christian Living
item.description: In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins explains Proverbs 4:23 and what it means to guard your heart in everyday Christian living.

item.title: Discerning the Voice of God: Scripture, the Spirit, and Modern Prophecy Claims
item.description: Discerning the voice of God biblically requires clarity about Scripture and the Spirit’s role. Learn how to test modern prophecy claims with confidence.
